subject: Revert "Make unit tests independent of the order they run in" (#5320)
reason: The change is a revert touching only unit-test files (src/unit/test_*.cpp), the CI workflow, and the removal of a test-only helper function in src/object.c (unitTestOnly_objectResetMetadataSize) that is never called by server code. No runtime behaviour of valkey-server or its tools changes, so no fuzzer scenario can reach or distinguish it.
